arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4827] URGENT — why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for reaching out and for your detailed description of what you’re experiencing. I understand how disruptive it is to keep losing your work-in-progress sessions when switching between machines, especially under deadline pressure.

From your description, it sounds like your Cursor "sign-in session" is ending whenever you log in on a new device. Based on our current documentation, there is no published policy or known change that intentionally signs customers out of previous sessions when authenticating with the same Google SSO account across multiple devices. Normally, you should be able to stay signed in on multiple machines at once.

The only documented behaviors that may cause repeated log-outs are related to browser cookie settings or manual sign-outs. Clearing cookies (especially for accounts.google.com) or signing in from a private/incognito browser window can sometimes cause sessions to end prematurely.

This issue might be a bug or a recent backend change not yet reflected in our documentation. Because you’re on a Pro plan and this is urgent, I will escalate this internally right away so a human support engineer can investigate account activity on the server side.

You should expect a follow-up from a human support specialist shortly. In the meantime, if you haven’t already, please double-check that cookies are enabled in your browsers for accounts.google.com, and avoid using incognito/private windows for now.

Thank you for your patience and for being a Pro customer.

Best regards,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Customer Support

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4815] Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thank you for letting us know about the issue with downloading your March invoice PDF. If the download button spins without completing (in both Chrome and Safari), it is usually due to a temporary problem with our billing PDF service or a network hiccup. Here are a few quick steps you can try:

1. Refresh the invoices page and try downloading again.
2. Clear your browser cache or try a different browser if available.
3. If your browser blocks third-party cookies, allow cookies for billing.cursor.com, as these are required for PDF downloads.

If this does not resolve the issue or you need the invoice urgently, please reply to this email and let us know. We can generate and send your invoice manually if needed.

Thank you for your patience!

Best regards,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Customer Support

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4820] Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thank you for reaching out with this feature request! At present, Cursor does not have a dedicated keyboard shortcut to trigger inline edit directly—you are correct that the current flow is to use Cmd-K and then select the option with your mouse.

We appreciate your suggestion and have noted this request for our product team. If you have any specific keybinding preferences or additional details on how this would help your workflow, feel free to reply and share them.

Thanks for helping us improve Cursor!

Best regards,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Customer Support
